name: MeiHua Holdings Group Co.,Ltd
summary: MeiHua Holdings Group Co.,Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures nutritional products and solutions in China and internationally. The company offers amino acids; l-threonine and l-lysine for livestock; umami agents comprising monosodium glutamate and I+G; food ingredients consisting of l-glutamine, l-proline, l-valine, isoleucine, adenosine, guanosine, and inosine; and colloids and polysaccharides, such as food-grade and industrial-grade xanthan gums, pullulan, and trehalose.
